title: PSAMA fence_mapping.json
description: Shape that pic-sure-auth-microapp parses at startup (FenceMappingUtility, BioDataCatalyst, StudyMetaData). PSAMA uses a default Jackson ObjectMapper, so ONE unknown field anywhere rejects the whole file and PSAMA starts with an empty mapping. Cross-entry rules (unique key, unique authZ, public entries) are not expressible here and live in FenceMappingValidator. See docs/FENCE_MAPPING.md.

study_identifier.description: Study accession, e.g. phs123456. First half of the PSAMA map key (FenceMappingUtility:58-61). Empty would produce keys like '.c1' that no HPDS partition matches.

study_type.description: 'public' (case-insensitive) grants the entry to every user (BdcConsentsBuilder:49-53); any other value is not used by PSAMA. The legacy generator copies the managed-input study type (e.g. parent, topmed, public).

abbreviated_name.description: Short study name. Parsed, not used by PSAMA.

full_study_name.description: Long study name. Parsed, not used by PSAMA.

consent_group_code.description: Consent group, e.g. c1. Key is study_identifier + '.' + code (phs123456.c1); empty or null gives the study-level key (bare phs123456). PSAMA does not constrain the value; the pattern is the shape the ETL partitions use.

consent_group_name_abv.description: Consent group abbreviation (e.g. GRU). Parsed, not used by PSAMA.

consent_group_name.description: Consent group full name. Parsed, not used by PSAMA.

request_access.description: dbGaP request-access URL. Parsed, not used by PSAMA.

data_type.description: Data type label. Parsed, not used by PSAMA.

clinical_variable_count.description: Count. Parsed into a primitive int, so a non-numeric value rejects the whole file. Minimum is -1 because the legacy generator defaults it to -1 (BDCMetadataElements); not used by PSAMA.

genetic_sample_size.description: Count. Parsed into a primitive int, so a non-numeric value rejects the whole file. Minimum is -1 because the legacy generator defaults it to -1 (BDCMetadataElements); not used by PSAMA.

clinical_sample_size.description: Count. Parsed into a primitive int, so a non-numeric value rejects the whole file. Minimum is -1 because the legacy generator defaults it to -1 (BDCMetadataElements); not used by PSAMA.

raw_clinical_variable_count.description: Count. Parsed into a primitive int, so a non-numeric value rejects the whole file. Minimum is -1 because the legacy generator defaults it to -1 (BDCMetadataElements); not used by PSAMA.

raw_genetic_sample_size.description: Count. Parsed into a primitive int, so a non-numeric value rejects the whole file. Minimum is -1 because the legacy generator defaults it to -1 (BDCMetadataElements); not used by PSAMA.

raw_clinical_sample_size.description: Count. Parsed into a primitive int, so a non-numeric value rejects the whole file. Minimum is -1 because the legacy generator defaults it to -1 (BDCMetadataElements); not used by PSAMA.

study_version.description: Study version. Parsed, not used by PSAMA.

study_phase.description: Study phase. Parsed, not used by PSAMA.

top_level_path.description: Top-level concept path, e.g. \\phs123456\\. Parsed, not used by PSAMA.

is_harmonized.description: 'Y' or 'Yes' (case-insensitive) means true, anything else false (IsHarmonizedDeserializer). Parsed, not used by PSAMA in production code.

study_focus.description: Study focus. Parsed, not used by PSAMA.

study_design.description: Study design. Parsed, not used by PSAMA.

authZ.description: FENCE authorization path the user logs in with (FENCEAuthenticationService:146); second key of the PSAMA mapping. Must be a non-null string: authZ.replace(...) at FenceMappingUtility:62 throws NullPointerException at startup.

additional_information.description: Free text. Parsed, not used by PSAMA.
